title: オークスの後に・ヒロインは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I lose the Japanese Oaks! But a princess keeps her head held high and pushes onward to her happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Besides, I have everyone's support! I really am the heroine! No one is more fit to be a princess than me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up, I'll conquer the Shuka Sho! Take this Princess☆Uppercut packed with fighting spirit!
